verdict.rationale: Featurebase ships a built-in AI agent, Fibi, that automatically resolves customer issues, so support work can be handed off to it. It is trained through the Training Data API, and AI is also used to surface impactful feedback opportunities. However, the evidence shows only a customer-facing support agent, not a general assistant the user can direct with arbitrary tasks inside the product. Missing for 10: evidence of a user-facing assistant that accepts delegated tasks across the product (e.g., managing feedback, roadmap or changelog actions), documentation of how tasks are assigned and executed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Let Fibi AI agent automatically resolve customer issues and cut down support loads for your team.
The Training Data API manages the knowledge available to your customer-support AI agent.
Featurebase helps you declutter & find the most impactful opportunities with AI.
